headline: Kunj Bihari Agarwal files SEBI Takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Rupa & Company Limited
sum: Kunj Bihari Agarwal has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a potential substantial acquisition event in Rupa & Company Limited, a leading Indian hosiery and textile player.
detail: Kunj Bihari Agarwal has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE. This disclosure is typically filed when a single promoter or group crosses or proposes to cross the 25% threshold of voting rights in a listed company. The filing marks the formal commencement of takeover code compliance obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations. Rupa & Company Limited is a publicly listed apparel and hosiery manufacturer with presence in domestic and export markets.
